runbooks.title: UI load balancer target is unhealthy
runbooks.summary: The Application Load Balancer reports unhealthy targets in the UI target group. Users may not reach aimeshfirewall.zeroshield.ai.
steps: SSH to the demo host and check container status: cd /home/ec2-user/AI_Mesh_Firewall && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps
Verify nginx/UI health: curl -sf -H "Host: aimeshfirewall.zeroshield.ai" http://127.0.0.1/ && curl -sf -H "Host: aimeshfirewall.zeroshield.ai" http://127.0.0.1/gw-health
If checks fail, redeploy: bash scripts/deploy-ec2.sh
If still failing, verify ALB health check path/port and security group ALB → EC2 on 80/443.

runbooks.title: Application stack health check failed
runbooks.summary: StackReady metric is 0 for 10+ minutes. Gateway, control, or nginx may be down after deploy or crash.
steps: SSH and inspect containers: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml ps
Check local health: curl http://127.0.0.1:8300/health && curl http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/health/
Redeploy: bash scripts/deploy-ec2.sh
Confirm StackReady=1 in CloudWatch namespace AIMeshFirewall/EC2 after deploy completes.

runbooks.title: Gateway ERROR log burst detected
runbooks.summary: More than 10 ERROR lines in gateway logs within 5 minutes. Check CloudWatch Live Tail for root cause.
steps: Open CloudWatch Live Tail on /ai-mesh-firewall/ec2/gateway
On EC2: docker compose logs gateway --tail 200
Check Bedrock/IAM and policy sync: curl -H "Host: {gateway_host}" http://127.0.0.1/health
Restart gateway if needed: docker compose up -d --force-recreate gateway

runbooks.title: Host memory above 90%
runbooks.summary: EC2 memory pressure may cause OOM kills of Docker containers.
steps: On EC2: free -h && docker stats --no-stream
Identify heavy containers; consider restarting workers/gateway if stuck
Check for memory leaks in gateway/control logs
If recurring, evaluate instance resize (current: c8g.2xlarge)

runbooks.title: Root or Docker disk above 85%
runbooks.summary: Disk full risk — Docker logs or images may fill /var/lib/docker.
steps: On EC2: df -h && du -sh /var/lib/docker/* | sort -h | tail
Prune unused Docker data: docker system prune -af (caution: removes unused images)
Bootstrap script configures json-file rotation; verify /etc/docker/daemon.json
Ensure demo stop uses scripts/demo-ec2-lifecycle.sh stop before EC2 stop

runbooks.title: EC2 status check failed
runbooks.summary: AWS reports hardware or reachability failure on the demo instance.
steps: Open EC2 console → Status checks tab
If reachability failed, stop/start instance (use demo-ec2-lifecycle.sh to manage alarms first)
After start, run: bash scripts/deploy-ec2.sh
Wait DEMO_ALARM_GRACE_SECONDS (900) before re-enabling alarms
